identity.name: Xaero Minimap × EMF Entity Icon Compatibility

goals: Retain accepted Canary 9 exactly as the user-reported external PASS baseline and exact Canary 10 as failed historical provenance, including its Bee and Rabbit row-level passes.

Repair only the C11 allowlisted Minecraft entities and five exact villager professions through verified effective EMF paths, explicit drawable anchors, bounded detached composition, and a separate effective Xaero presentation-stage scale policy.
Keep every unlisted entity and villager profession on the exact C9 path; do not transfer C9 or C10 runtime evidence to Canary 11.
scope: Reuse the existing C9 failed-upstream EMF-to-Xaero seam and canonical-frame adapter without modifying its generic selector; C11 enters only for exact fox, goat, frog, bogged, witch, and the five declared minecraft:villager professions.

Use only detached icon-only C11 compositions on effective trees: fox and goat body/EMF_body/EMF_head2 with goat's drawable EMF_snout trace anchor; frog body/EMF_body/EMF_body2 direct lower-face cubes plus EMF_head2; Bogged hat/EMF_headwear; Witch body/EMF_body transforms with only EMF_head2 and EMF_hat; and profession-gated villager head/nose/EMF_nose direct face base plus EMF_face, EMF_frog_eyes, and the exact matching hat. Preserve required parent transforms without copying their cubes and fail closed to C9 if the contract or explicit drawable trace is absent.

Preserve Bee and Rabbit's working 0.75 Xaero request-scale path. Apply 1.50 only to ghast and happy_ghast immediately before Xaero's model-form baseScale because Xaero skips Parameters.scale at or above 1.0; never compound both C11 paths. Preserve C9 one-retry-per-variant/resource-generation cache ownership and Naturalist/Ribbits companion boundaries.

exclusions: Broad selector changes, wildcard entity/profession matching, whole-body icons, live model mutation, world-model scaling, and unsupported runtime claims.
Changes to Naturalist, Ribbits, upstream Xaero, Fresh Animations, EMF, ETF or other projects.
Static mob icons, copied upstream assets or classes, replacement entity rendering, networking, server behavior, and redistribution of Xaero's All Rights Reserved content.
The retired Diagnostic2 source workspace, unretained generated outputs, legacy status narratives, Test Instance Manager state, deployment ledgers, snapshots, and historical administrative matrices.
Runtime deployment, Minecraft launch, either Test Slot, accepted-baseline mutation, map-data changes, and access to the protected gameplay instance during this migration.
Dedicated-server, exhaustive all-mob, per-check Canary 3, or other runtime validation not present in the frozen evidence.
